findings.detail: v1.3.52 progress did not consume sk:ctu-ai-applied / sk:ctu-photo-ai-requested, so programmatically populated AI values could be absent from progress provenance.
photo-loaded now causes a progress re-evaluation without accepting any field, preventing photo presence alone from completing progress.
sk:ctu-excel-imported remains the source event after imported values are written to quickMass/quickCargoDescription and route fields.
Sample application rows extracted year 2026, application 1234, applicant, vessel, POL/POD, UN1203, package count and N/W/G/W correctly.

Initial defaults stay unaccepted; Excel marks cargo only; photo load alone changes nothing; photo AI marks changed securing candidates; AI apply marks confirmed changed values; calculation then enables registration.

limitations: Photo AI image-recognition quality depends on the actual uploaded photo; the verification here covers code path and system-event linkage, not accuracy for every real-world image.
